About.label: About
About.title: Passionate about crafting web experiences
About.p1: I'm a front-end developer who loves turning ideas into real interfaces: fast, responsive, and enjoyable to use.
About.p2: I mainly work with React and Next.js, with great attention to detail, performance, and UX across all screens.

p1.title: E-commerce Store
p1.desc: A responsive e-commerce platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I developed the user interface, integrated REST APIs, implemented authentication, product categories and brands, shopping cart, wishlist, orders, and checkout with online payment integration.

features.authentication: Implemented user authentication and protected user pages.
features.products: Built product browsing with categories, brands, filtering, and product details.
features.cart: Implemented shopping cart functionality with adding, updating, and removing products.
features.wishlist: Implemented wishlist functionality and product management.
features.orders: Implemented order creation and order history.
features.checkout: Implemented checkout flow with cash and online payment options.
